newsitem.title: GERMANY: German association revises 96 truck sales outlook.
newsitem.headline: German association revises 96 truck sales outlook.

text.p: The VDIK German association of vehicle importers said on Thursday that it has lowered its expectations for total 1996 German commercial vehicle sales growth by about six percent from its earlier projection.
The association said it now expected about 250,000 registrations during the current year, a drop of 4.2 percent from the 1995 level of 261,000 vehicles.
The association earlier in 1996 had predicted a rise in sales to 266,000 units.
During the first seven months of the year, the VDIK said a total of 146,676 commercial vehicles were sold, 7.1 percent lower than the year-ago period.
The VDIK said the drop was due to stiff international competition and the weak German economy, particularly in the construction industry.
But the association noted that truck importers in Germany had improved their market share to almost 36 percent during the first half of the year from the year-ago level of 35.3 percent.
